title: Add Up the Tips of a 7-Point Star | AMC 8-Style Level 4
description:
Seven points on a circle, joined into a star. What do the seven tip angles add up to? Vantee shows two ways: cut the circle into slices from the center, and walk a pencil around the star and count its turns. Then see why each wrong answer is tempting, and try a pointier star yourself.
